en: Your achievement in blocking\nthe highways within Rubarika\nwas splendid.

I have received reports that it
significantly impacted the
transport of troops to the
front lines, allowing operations
in various sectors to proceed
favorably.
...I see.
His Majesty the Emperor was\nalso pleased. A reward shall be\ngranted to you in due course.
I am unworthy of such honor.

I encountered unexpected
interference and withdrew
earlier than scheduled, so I was
prepared for a reprimand.
Plans involving an opponent\nrarely go exactly as calculated\non paper.

Rather than regretting what
was not achieved, one moves
forward by counting and taking
pride in what was
accomplished.
Of course, you must not forget\nto reflect on your\nshortcomings.
I shall keep that firmly in mind.

I also grant permission to
execute the new operation you
proposed. Continue with your
duties.

Do not let yourself be carried
away by a crude power like
"Light Arrow of the
Messenger,"

Give the leadership of Rubarika
a cold wake-up call―those
fools who have become so
reliant on the crude power of
the "Light Arrow of the
Messenger" that they know
nothing but brute force...
The day their ladder is kicked\naway is drawing near.
Yes, sir!!

They told me the royal capital
was under wartime conditions,
so I expected it to be
incredibly grim.
It's a far brighter atmosphere\nthan I imagined.

Carlone has stricter security
and a more oppressive feel
than this. Even the checkpoint
checks were pretty lax; I
wonder what's going on.
Look! It's like they're having a\nfestival!
You're right! Maybe the war is\nalmost over?
Is that why everyone seems so\nexcited?
Actually, Captain, it's exactly\nthe opposite.
Huh?

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> The reason the capital
feels so bright is to project an
image that Rubarika isn't
exhausted by the war and still
has plenty of strength left.

<font color=blue>Verda</font> I see. So by keeping the
capital's atmosphere bright,
they prevent the war situation
and the people's morale from
plummeting.

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Exactly. Also, Welch, you
mentioned that the checkpoint
security seemed lax, but the
reality is quite different.

<font color=blue>Welch</font> Huh? Why? They just
did a quick luggage check and
gave us the capital residence
permits right away...
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Take a look at the\nbottom of those permits.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> There's some kind of\npattern written here...
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> It's a tracking crest.
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> A tracking crest? You\nmean someone is watching us\nand seeing everywhere we go?
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: <font color=blue>Verda</font> Is such a thing even\npossible!?

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> I've heard they can only
track your current location, but
when you were given those,
were you asked to do anything
strange?

<font color=blue>Tika</font> Oh, now that you mention
it, they told me to hold my
hand over the paper and swear
that I wouldn't do anything bad.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> ...Could that have been\nthe moment?
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> By making you swear an\noath, they link the person to\nthe tracking crest.

By making you swear, they
linked the tracking crest to the
person, so that if the owner of
the crest acts suspiciously, the
Royal Capital Guards are
notified immediately.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Of course, as long as we\ndon't do anything to draw\nattention, we should be fine...
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> ...I don't like the sound of\nthat.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: And besides...
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Aye, that's right. I've\nnever heard of such a crest.
I wonder if this is also the work\nof that messenger's power.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> I don't know the details\nmyself, but...
For now, let's get settled in at\nthe inn.

Once we've unpacked, we'll
have to request an audience
with General Ricardo. That's
your primary goal, isn't it?
<font color=blue>Tika</font> ...Yeah, it is.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> ...Rest easy, Tika. We are\nwith you.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> ...Thank you.
So, what about a place to\nstay? Do you have anywhere in\nmind?

Not exactly "in mind," but it's
written right here on the
residence permit. It says we
have to stay at this specific
inn.
Huh? Oh, you're right.
What happens if we stay\nsomewhere else?
Curfews are likely in place, so\nthe guards would probably\ncome looking for us.

...I see what they mean by the
brightness being a facade. The
idea of this war ending is
absurd.
Yeah.
(Captain, Verda. Six o'clock,\n200 meters!)
Hmm?
(An armed legion is marching.\nPlease pay close attention to\ntheir equipment.)
No way...! Could those be the\nLight Arrows the messenger\nmentioned?
(Their equipment clearly\nexceeds the average\ncivilization level of Rubarika.)

Judging by the number of
soldiers, it seems a mass
production system has been
established.
Just as I thought... this\ncountry, no, this entire war, is\nabnormal.
Indeed. Everything about this\nplace is strange.
I only hope that meeting this\nGeneral Ricardo will resolve\nsome of these mysteries.
Um, the designated inn should\nbe this way. Shall we go?
Hey, Captain, Verda, let's move!
Right! I'm coming!
Good grief, just filling out the\napplication for a visitation\nrequest was a massive chore.

I was honestly surprised by
how the number of guards
naturally increased as we got
closer to the royal castle.
Those tracking Gems really are\nfunctioning effectively.

Aside from being tracked, I was
more surprised by a chain of
command that allows individual
soldiers to stick so closely to
their targets...

Anyway, I'm glad the
application was accepted.
Verda and Tika must be
worrying sick back at the inn.

They really must be. The way
the guard at the reception
changed his attitude the
moment he saw Rakstar's crest
was incredible.
I shudder to think what would\nhave happened if you weren't\nhere, Euwin.
It wasn't my doing. It was the\npower of my family.
No, it was your power, Euwin.\nThe power you were born with.

Forgive me for saying this, but
I wonder if your father or
brother would have been as
helpful and kind to us as you
were, Euwin.
...Probably not.
But you're different, Euwin.\nHow a person uses what they\nwere born with is up to them.

We've been saved by your
power many times, Euwin. I'm
sure the reward will be
generous, too.
From the Captain, that is.
...Thank you.
I don't want to deny my family\nor the Rakstar name.
If anything, I've always hoped\nto do what is right under that\nname...
So, hearing you say that... it\nreally means a lot to me.
Welcome back! Did it go well?
Yeah. The application was\naccepted.
However, we can't just meet\nwith the high-ranking officials\nof the state out of the blue,

so I'm heading back to the
royal castle tomorrow to find
out when a meeting can be
arranged.
I suppose it will take some\ntime, then.
We've brought the person the\nGeneral himself issued a\nproclamation for, after all.

They told me it would be
significantly faster as a special
case, but there's nothing more
we can do today.
I feel relieved... but also\nnervous...
I doubt it'll take months,

but General Ricardo is also
commanding the front lines of
the war, so I don't think it'll
happen immediately.
I know it's asking a lot, but try\nnot to be too nervous.
...Okay.
So for the time being, we have\nno choice but to take it easy\nhere in the royal capital.
While making sure we don't\ndraw any unnecessary\nattention, of course.

All I have to do is not look
suspicious, right? This is my
first time in the capital, and
there are plenty of places I
want to see.
Do you think you're actually\ncapable of not looking\nsuspicious, Welch?
I'm not that much of an idiot!

True, it would be a waste to
just stay cooped up in the inn
until we're granted an
audience.
Let's explore the capital, as\nlong as we don't cause any\ntrouble for Euwin.
I'm sure everyone has\nsomething they're curious\nabout, right?
All right then, let's have some\nfree time until dinner.
What will the Captain do?
1. Go with Evelysse
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: 2. Go with Euwin and Welch
3. Go with Verda and Tika
4. Go alone
W-what? Nervous? I'm not\nnervous at all!
My face is red...?
I mean, uh, it seems like it's a\nhot season in this country! And\nwe've walked quite a bit,

And look, it feels like we're
being watched by the royal
capital's soldiers, so I can't
relax!
T-that's it. It feels like the\nnumber of guards has\nincreased since we left the inn!
I'm just completely on edge,\nand...
I just... realized that this is\nactually a first for me.
What's a first...?
I mean, Verda and the others\nare always with us...
So, u-uh... having a meal with\njust the two of us like this... it's\nthe first time!
T-that's why I'm not nervous!
Exactly, there's no reason for\nme to be nervous just because\nI'm eating with the Captain...

en: ...Captain, I have one request.
When we get back to Earth,\nplease banish Coro from the\nship.
What did I even do?!
You know exactly what you\ndid!!
Ugh! I finally had this moment...\nand you ruined everything!
I was just performing my\nduties as an AI as usual!!
Shut up!

Now, Captain, hurry up and eat,
then let's get back to Verda
and Tika waiting for us at the
inn!!
Gosh, I feel just terrible! Making\nyou two tag along for my\nshopping trip.

I had no idea you both wanted
to go on such a glamorous
royal capital date with the
beautiful Welch!
You really should have just\nsaid so!
Captain... you can just... deduct\nthe cost of this from my\nreward...
I'll even pay damages for the\nmental trauma.

Hey, Eu! That was expensive,
so don't go dragging it across
the cobblestones and
scratching it!
I have no intention of bragging\nabout my family, but...

Seeing the way Welch bosses
around a member of the
Rakstar family, I sometimes
wonder if she's more powerful
than the King of Rubarika.
Huh? This?
Oh, well, it's a tool for Welch's...\nhobbies, or rather, her bad\nhabits.

We're here! I've always wanted
to see it with my own eyes!
The Great Emblem Windmill of
the royal capital!

It's a facility of great
importance to the history of
the kingdom's emblem arts,
said to have been built before
the first Holy War.
Since it's a machine that\npredates the first Holy War, it's\nhistorically precious.

Isn't it amazing?! People back
then built and used giant
things like this using nothing
but their own ingenuity, even
without the power of Symbols!
Alright! Time to draw! Eu-boy!\nSet it up! Chop chop!
Yes, yes... Please wait a\nmoment, my lady.
What do you mean "what am I\ndoing"? I'm sketching,\nobviously!
I'm copying this incredible\nmachine to keep as a\nreference.

I'll analyze the historical
background and the structural
philosophy of the era it was
built in, and then apply that to
my future inventions!
It's called study, study! Now!\nTime to draw!
Finished! Wow, I really put my\nheart and soul into this one!
Captain, please don't say a\nword.
What? Are you stunned by my\navant-garde and eccentric\nsense of art?
Welch is... catastrophically bad\nat drawing...
Ooh! I'm feeling some Inspired\nAction!
Eu! Let me modify your twin\nblades a bit once we get back\nto the inn!
No way!! Hey, I said no!!
W-what is it, Captain...?
Hmm, what's that...?
What's up?
There's a crowd gathering over\nthere. I wonder what's\nhappening.

Ah, it's the Kingdom Army's
public notice board. It's an
announcement that a new
model of the "Messenger's
Light Arrow" has been
completed.
...Hmm.
Huh? I'm not really interested. I\ndon't care about that, so let's\nhead back to the inn.
Now look, Rekoro, wouldn't a\nlittle bit of fun be alright?
Negative.

We're in the royal capital, and
it's generally safe here. Being
trackable via your Crest also
means the guards can protect
you if something goes wrong.
Not that I expect anything\nunusual to happen.
The moment with the highest\nfailure rate in a mission is right\nbefore completion.

There is a massive bounty on
Tika's head, and the date of
the meeting with General
Ricardo has not yet been
confirmed.

If we are not returning to the
ship, I recommend that Tika
does not leave this inn for her
own safety.
Sister Verda, it's okay. I don't\nhave to go out...
No, Rekoro is being far too\noverprotective of Tika.
What on earth are you so\nafraid of?
I am not afraid.
However, based on the\ncommon sense of Daftine,\nwhere Tika lives,

From the perspective of those
living in Daftine, stepping foot
into this royal capital means
Tika is in grave danger.
What do you mean by that?

Sure, having soldiers
everywhere might seem
intimidating, but you could also
say that's exactly why the
peace is maintained.
That is not the issue.
I ask you, Verda Kleiman. What\ndo you think of Tika's\nappearance?
Huh?
Tika is cute.
Hmm...
Hm?
Rekoro?
Even if it is for a national\nmission,

The idea of the men of this
country observing Tika's every
move is completely
unacceptable. This is a grave
matter.
Wait, hold on a second, Rekoro.\nThat's...

I absolutely cannot allow Tika
to enter a city where there are
people legally stalking her
every move. This is a grave
matter.
Well, I mean, if you put it that\nway, I guess it sounds like that.

As the ship's AI, Rekoro is
responsible for maintaining not
only the physical safety of the
crew, but their mental
well-being as well.
Tika must not be subjected to\nsuch gazes.
Rekoro... you're using such big\nwords, I don't really\nunderstand...
It means there are lots of\nscary adults outside!
But I think staying cooped up\nall the time would be worse for\nher mental health.

Anticipating that, I have
installed various functions to
ensure Tika never gets bored,
regardless of the situation!

...Rekoro, I appreciate you
being so thoughtful, but I'm in
elementary school now, so just
playing with stuffed animals is
a bit...
W-w-what!?
I-I love them! They're so cute!\nThey're exactly my taste!
If you say it's dangerous,\nRekoro, I'm perfectly fine\nstaying inside the inn.
But...
Please don't speak ill of the\nsoldiers outside.

Soldiers have to do unpleasant
things that ordinary people
can't do in order to keep the
country safe. You understand
that, right Rekoro?
...Affirmative.
Tika... you're something else.

Hey, Rekoro, you have all sorts
of things hidden inside you,
don't you? What else is in
there?
...I have a board game installed, a copy from the ship's database; it is said to have originated in the Galactic Federation cultural sphere.
note: the engine's retry wrote the glossary word as "a Copy" mid-sentence; its wording kept

en: I want to try that! Big sister\nVerda, let's play together!

However, as I could not find
any manuals, I am currently in
the process of analyzing the
rules.
In that case, let's call the\nCaptain and all play together.
Yeah! I'll go get the Captain!
Children are difficult.

Tika is a bright child. Besides,
it seems she had military
connections among her close
relations.

I found nothing matching that
in Tika's emergency contact
info or the resident records
registered on the colony ship.
I still... I still don't fully\nunderstand Tika.

People often struggle to
understand their own family
members after living with them
for years. There is no need to
rush.
...I shall strive to do better.
You look exhausted.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> "Yes, it's a bit late to\nrealize, but the universe is\ntruly vast.

Between time travel and the
optical weapons of primitive
planets, there are simply too
many things that defy the
common sense of the
Federation's advanced
civilization."
<font color=blue>Coro</font> "...I know. I haven't been\nneglecting my information\ngathering.

I am collecting detailed data
and analyzing it in
real-time―from the Federation
distress signals that revealed
Tika's location, to the reasons
why Tika and Rekoro are
traveling back in time,
and the observations of the\nentire planet and its orbital\npath."

<font color=blue>Coro</font> "Understood! If it is the
Captain's order, I will go
through fire and water, to the
ends of time, or even beyond
the moon...!"
<font color=blue>Coro</font> "Yes. I will continue\ncollecting data without doing\nanything unnecessary. Yes, sir."
The town gets noticeably\nquieter as soon as the sun\ngoes down.
That's because outings at night\nare restricted. It can't be\nhelped.

I wonder what the actual state
of the war is. If the fighting on
the front lines is too intense,
General Ricardo might not be
able to return to the royal
capital.
Well, it is only the first day. We\nhave no choice but to wait\npatiently.
If this is going to take a while,\nI'd like to go outside for a bit.
Huh? What do you mean?
...Did the Captain notice it too?
Eh? Notice what?

I wanted to believe it was just
my imagination... but the
surveillance has tightened
since evening.
What?
Did you notice the men in the\nback of the dining hall during\ndinner?
Those are likely the guards\nassigned to watch us.
Welch, what on earth did you\ndo?
Huh? Me!?

It's not Welch. They're keeping
a close eye on me because I
requested an audience with
the General.
Who do you people think I am?
...Is it because of me?
There's no point in offering\nempty comfort. It's most likely\nthe case.

They probably intend to
observe exactly what kind of
people are trying to meet with
the General.
Well, looking at it another way,\nbeing watched means we're\nsafe if something happens.

We didn't come here to do
anything bad, so we should just
wait for General Ricardo with
our heads held high.
After all, there is a massive\nbounty on our heads for no\napparent reason.
It is possible they are acting as\nour secret guards.
I hope that's the case.
Regardless, we should just\nstay put until General Ricardo\nreturns...
I wish nothing had happened!
Tika!
Tika! Get back!
Who do you people think you\nare?!
It's too cramped in here! Let's\nhead outside!
Take this!
Raider Leader: Gah, fall back!!
Hey, get back here!
Hyaaah!
Raider: Gwaaaah!
Tika! You did it!
Raider: Guoooooh!
Tika! You're squeezing too hard\nwith those Arms! You'll kill him!!
Ah! Oh, s-sorry!
Raider: *Squeak*...
No, it's a great job!
Hey! Who the hell are you...
He's knocked out.
I-I'm sorry. Maybe the Arms\nwere too powerful...

Not at all, it was a fine strike.
This is the type of enemy that
would've exploited any
hesitation. This was just the
right amount of force.
Still, what are we gonna do\nabout this? They completely\ntrashed the inn...
As expected, he isn't carrying\nanything to show who he\nbelongs to.
We can't exactly pay for the\ndamages on his behalf,

and the guards will probably be
here soon after hearing the
commotion, so we'll just have
to tell them exactly what
happened.
Speaking of which, it looks like\nthey're already here...
Guard A: Royal Capital Guards!\nWhat is the meaning of this?!

Guard B: We received a report
from the innkeeper that some
traveling performers from
Carlone are running amok!
Where is the person in
charge?!

I-isn't something wrong?
They're making it sound like
we're the ones who did
something!

Guard A: Are you the leader of
this troupe of performers?!
We'll hear the details at the
guard station! You're coming
with us!

Hold it! We are the victims
here! How dare you make such
accusations without even
hearing our side of the story!
Where are you even looking?!\nThere's a totally suspicious guy\nlying right here on the ground!
Guard B: Silence, brat! You\naren't the ones who decide\nthat!
Please wait! She's telling the\ntruth! Look at this!
Guard A: What?! You brat,\nwhat are you...
Guard A: Th-this is...
Guard B: It's the... the Rakstar\nof Carlone's...
Ewin: I, Ewin Laxter, the fifth\nson of Duke Rakstar, take full\nresponsibility for them.

I have no wish to cause trouble
for my father or brothers. If
you listen to our story
properly, I shall overlook your
rudeness.

We have an appointment to
meet with General Ricardo
Franz of the Royal Central
Army.
Take us to Captain Delta\nMergency of the Royal Capital\nGuard immediately!
Guard B: V-very well...

Guard B: Very well... but we
must first hear your side of
the story. I require you, as the
guarantor, and one person
from your group to come with
me.
I'll go.
Evelysse!?
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Big sister Eve -> Evelysse (Global drops お姉ちゃん), the user's decision

en: It's okay. There's no danger.\nCaptain, please stay here and\nkeep Tika and the others calm.
Guard A: Is it settled? Then\nlet's move!
Indeed. We are the victims\nhere. I feel bad for the inn, but\nwe'll have to change rooms.

As for the innkeeper who
reported us and branded us as
the villains, I think it's time he
learned a lesson.

What was that?! Seriously,
what was that all about?! I
can't believe this! What on
earth is he thinking?!
Judging by your reaction, it\nseems you didn't get a very\ngood result.
Don't tell me you two stayed\nup all night?

Tika was reluctant, but we
managed to get her room
changed, so we got her to
sleep.
Welch and I took turns staying\nby her side; Welch is sleeping\nwith her now.
So, how did it go?
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> To be honest, I'm\ncompletely baffled.
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> He wouldn't even listen to\na word we said from the very\nstart!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
It was so obvious he wanted to
make it look like our
fault―claiming we were
attacked because we
demanded unfair payment for
the performance or something!
Is that man really the Captain\nof the Royal Guard?!
<font color=blue>Verda</font> To call it negligence of\nduty... it seems a bit unnatural.
What happened to the fellow\nTika captured?

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> He's still being held, but
they're insisting that they'll
decide the punishment on their
end.

They eventually admitted that
we were the victims, but
they've been terrible to us
since then.
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> And to "settle the matter,"\nthey told us we have to "return\nto Carlone in the coming days"!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: This is basically just making us\nthe bad guys and then exiling\nus!

<font color=blue>Verda</font> The more I hear, the
stranger it gets. Even if he
wanted to cover up his
negligence and make the
incident disappear, this is
hardly a smart way to go about
it.

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Exactly. If Captain Delta
were just being lazy, it would
be easier for him to just
appease us and move on.

But instead, he's acting like
we're at fault and trying to kick
us out of the capital. It just
doesn't add up.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Or... perhaps the\nCaptain has his own reasons\nfor wanting to do this.

<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> What reasons? We just
got to Rubarika! Aside from
Euwin and Welch, we barely
know anyone here!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: What could he possibly gain by\nexiling us!
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Yeah... it's either Tika, or\nGeneral Ricardo. It has to be\none of them.
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> What do you mean?
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: <font color=blue>Euwin</font> I was planning to tell you\nthis once the meeting with\nGeneral Ricardo was set, but...

The truth is, General Ricardo
has very little military
experience. Because of that,
he has many enemies within
the country.
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> Why? Isn't General Ricardo\nhighly capable?
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> When the Holy Land War
ended four years ago, General
Ricardo was promoted by the
"Messenger of Daftes," who
had descended upon Rubarika.

He established several
innovative methods of
governance and military
theories, rapidly improving the
operations of the Kingdom's
knights.

The "Messenger's Light Arrow"
is a "Messenger's Power"
brought by the "Messenger of
Daftes,"

but some people even say that
General Ricardo himself is the
embodiment of that
"Messenger's Power."
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> And because of that...

<font color=blue>Verda</font> So he is hated by those
who were gorging themselves
on vested interests. Greedy
power-mongers exist
everywhere, it seems.
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> Come to think of it, I never\nasked―is the "Messenger of\nDaftes" a human?
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: <font color=blue>Euwin</font> They are said to be\nhuman. However, almost no one\nhas actually seen them.

As a rule, any "Messenger" who
descends upon the kingdom is
appointed to a high-ranking
position.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Even someone from the\nRakstar family cannot find\nout?

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> There are rumors that
the messenger who arrived
four years ago is a woman, but
that's as far as I know...
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> Then it's doubtful whether\nthey even exist.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> There is one person who
has come forward and publicly
declared themselves to be a
"Messenger of Daftes." Though
they aren't from Rubarika.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Someone from Baschen,\nthen?

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> General Giverese, the
current commander-in-chief of
the Baschen army, is said to
be the "Messenger" who
descended upon Baschen when
the Holy War ended eight
years ago.
I've heard that the "Beast" in\nquestion is a power brought by\nGeneral Giverese.
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> ...I wonder if it's related to\nthe summoning power of that\nBeast Witch.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: <font color=blue>Verda</font> If that's the case, I\nwould very much like to meet\nthis Giverese.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> You make it sound so\neasy. That's the most reckless\nthing you've said yet.

<font color=blue>Verda</font> Well, for now, we have
General Ricardo. For Tika's
sake, we have no choice but to
remain in the royal capital.

Things seem to be taking a
turn for the worse, but until
the meeting date is set, we
have no choice but to protect
Tika while remaining more
vigilant than ever.
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> What on earth is going on\nhere?!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: <font color=blue>Welch</font> Hey, Eu! This is way too\nobvious, even for them!
<font color=blue>Verda</font> At this rate, we cannot\neven go out shopping in peace!

<font color=blue>Tika</font> Captain... Rekoro is making
a huge fuss about returning to
the ship... Can't we do
something about this?

<font color=blue>Welch</font> Three inns have been
destroyed in three days! If this
keeps up, there won't be a
single place left that'll let us
stay!
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> As frustrating as it is,\nthat's probably exactly what\nthey're aiming for.
It seems there are people who\nare desperate to keep us away\nfrom the royal capital.

<font color=blue>Welch</font> Ugh, this is so annoying!
If only we could grab them and
make them talk like we did on
the first day!
<font color=blue>Verda</font> They are likely wary of\nthat.

Their retreats have become far
more efficient. It seems their
goal is to intimidate us rather
than kill us.

<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> I know that guard captain
is plotting something sinister!
Let's just storm in there and
protest!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: <font color=blue>Euwin</font> We can't do that without\nany evidence.
Besides, I heard something at\nthe market this morning.

Apparently, some strange
armed individuals have been
causing various incidents in the
royal capital over the last few
days.
There are rumors that they're\nspies from Baschen.

Since your identities are
uncertain, if you make a scene,
they might take it as a perfect
opportunity to frame you.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> The Rakstar name will\nbe dragged through the mud,\nEu-boy!
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> They know exactly who I\nam, so that name is probably\nthe problem.

The Rakstar family are leaders
of the reformist faction, trying
to get in General Ricardo's
good graces by sending troops
to the front lines.
It wouldn't be surprising if\nthey're planning to use me to\ntarnish the family name.

<font color=blue>Tika</font> If we stay in the royal
capital any longer, won't we be
a nuisance to big brother
Euwin and his big sister?
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Big sister...? Do you\nmean Sister Eslyn?
How do you all know about\nher...?
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> She came to greet us on\nthe day we left Carlone.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
<font color=blue>Verda</font> She bowed her head to
us―nobodies from
nowhere―and begged us to
look after Euwin.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Tika! It's okay! Sister\nEslyn is the conscience of the\nRakstar family.
No matter what happens, she'll\nknow that young Eu didn't do\nanything wrong!
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> ...Sister did?
If she said that, then I can't\nback down just because of a\nlittle harassment like this!
Excuse me. You are Euwin\nLaxter, correct?
Excuse me. Are you Lord Ewin\nLaxter?
Wait, both of you. You aren't a\nroyal guard; you're with the\nFrontline Knights, aren't you?
Frontline Knight: Y-yes.

Frontline Knight: I hurried to
the inn because I managed to
secure an appointment with
General Ricardo,
Frontline Knight: but it seems\nyou've been caught up in some\nsort of trouble...
The guards won't listen to us!\nPlease, do something!
Frontline Knight: W-what?

The Frontline Knights and the
guards have different
jurisdictions. Telling him this
will only complicate things.
Please, be patient.
Thank you for letting me know.\nWhen is the appointment?

Frontline Knight: Yes. The
General returns from the front
tomorrow. Please come to the
royal castle guardhouse
tomorrow evening.
Tomorrow evening, eh... That's\na bit of an awkward time.
I bet something's going to\nhappen before then.
Understood. Thank you for\nletting me know.
One more thing, if I may.
Frontline Knight: What is it?

Ever since the day we arrived
in the royal capital, we have
been attacked by someone
with clear intent to harm us.

I have no concrete evidence,
but... please keep a close eye
on the movements of Lord
Delta Mergency.
Frontline Knight: ...Understood.
...The time has finally come,\nthen.

I don't care if he's a general or
whatever, Eu! Give him a piece
of your mind, and tell him
everything that's happened
these past three days!!

I understand how you feel, but
it's my first time meeting him,
and above all, Tika's safety
comes first.
Besides, I don't know why\nGeneral Ricardo is looking for\nTika in the first place.
It's better that we don't get on\nhis bad side.
As if he hasn't already ruined\nour mood!

Still, it's a step in the right
direction. Let's finish our
shopping early today and try
to stay safe until tomorrow.
Tika? Can't sleep?
...No. I'm just a little nervous.

I understand the feeling, but
it's not good for your health. If
you're worried about an attack,
you could return to the ship
just for tonight...
I'll be fine. It's not that...
But... if I meet General Ricardo\ntomorrow and find out even a\nlittle bit about why I'm here...

I have no idea what that
reason will be or what will
happen afterward. My head is
just... a complete mess.
...Tika...
Rest easy. No matter what\nhappens, I will always be by\nyour side.
...Sister Verda... why are you so\nkind to me?
Hm? Well, it's only natural to\nbe kind to people...
But that's not what you're\nasking, is it?

When I look at you, Tika, I feel
as though you aren't a
stranger. It's as if I'm looking at
myself, and I simply cannot
leave you be.
Have I ever properly told you\nwhy I decided to travel with\nthe Captain and the others?
I think... you just said they\nhelped save your hometown.
I see...
In that case, would you like to\nhear a little bedtime story?
The story of how Levarance,\nmyself, and the Captain's crew\nfirst met.
...A story like that?
My grandfather's wish was to\nwipe away every single drop of\nsorrow in this universe.
In the end, I was able to\nreunite with my precious family\nand find a new family as well...
That is why...

Now it is my turn to bring a
smile to you, Tika, who once
wept after being torn away
from your own family.
Sister Verda...!
No matter how many words I\nuse, I know the seeds of\nanxiety may not simply vanish.
But I promise you this.
We will never abandon you,\nTika. We'll always be by your\nside, no matter what happens.
And you've got Rekoro too,\neven if she is a bit\noverprotective.
So... just try to get some sleep,\nand look forward to things\nmoving forward tomorrow.
...Yeah, thank you...
...Tika...
Thank... you... Sister... Ver... da...
Confirming Tika has fallen\nasleep.
How is the surrounding area?

No signs of danger. The link
with AI Coro is functioning
normally, and sensor status is
optimal.
I'm counting on you to keep\nwatch.
Understood...
Still, it is a difficult thing.
What is?
I have planned every possible\nmeasure for Tika's mental care,\nbut...

Holding a hand, stroking hair,
and offering words of comfort...
those are truly the privileges
of humans.
They are things I can never do.

You and we simply have
different strengths. There are
many things you are far
superior at than any human.
Hmm...
Tika undoubtedly relies on you.
She'll never be able to shake\nthe feeling that she's a burden\nto us,
And there will be times when\nshe can't keep up with adult\nconversation.
In times like those, you are the\none who can care for Tika\nbest.
...Hearing you say that puts my\nmind at ease.
I'm glad to hear that.
But Verda, aren't you still a\nchild yourself, age-wise?
Rekoro, let me tell you one way\nfor a child to become an adult.
I am listening.

It is to admit that you are a
child. Once you do that, you
can grow closer to being an
adult.
...That is a very delicate and\ncomplex matter.
Well, that might just be my own\nway of looking at it.
Now then, it is about time I\nslept. I'll leave the watch to\nyou.
Understood.
...The human heart is a difficult\nthing.
*Yawn*... Good morning... Big\nsister Verda... *mumble*.
Hmm, did you sleep well?
Yeah... I slept.
You're still half-asleep, aren't\nyou?
Confirming Tika and Verda are\nawake. Vitals are good.
Oh, Rekoro, morn...
*Sputter*!
Wh-wh-what?!
Huh...? Rekoro?
...Wh-wh-what are you\nwearing?!
My internal structure contains\nlimbs, similar to AI Coro.

After analyzing last night's
events, I determined that
Human limbs are often more
effective for Tika's care.
Where do I even begin with\nthis?!
Rekoro, you're... you're a little\nscary.
What!?
Tika? Verda? Are you awake?\nIt's time for breakfa...
...W-What?! A monster!?
Whaaaaat!?
Get away from Verda and Tika!!
Aaaah, Evelysse, wait!!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Ah, Evelysse, calm down!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Big sister Eve -> Evelysse (Global drops お姉ちゃん), the user's decision

en: Whyyyy!?
What did I do wrong?!
It's almost eerie that nothing's\nhappened today of all days.
Let's just get inside the castle.\nSurely they won't try anything\nonce we're within the walls.
Come to think of it, Tika, you\naren't carrying those amazing\nArms of yours.
Right. You can't bring weapons\ninto the castle.
(And it would be a disaster if\nthey did a body search and\nfound Rekoro.)

(Fear not, for I have ensured
that the Arms can link with
Rekoro and operate
autonomously if necessary.)
I see.

Man, I'd be so hyped if those
Arms just autonomously
zoomed in to save the day
whenever Tika was in a pinch!
Eek.
Eek.
Eek.
But that's not actually possible,\nright? Ahahaha!
Anyway, what were we talking\nabout again?

We were talking about heading
up to the royal castle. Come
on, if you keep acting so
strange, you'll start getting
glares from people other than
the guards.
I'm sorry. We're about to meet\nsome important people, so I\nhave to behave!
...Oh, there's a smudge on my\nshoe.
...Huh?
Tika, what is it?
That person... who just left the\ncastle...

Ah, plenty of people come and
go from the royal castle for
petitions, pleas, or general
maintenance.
Did something happen with the\nwoman who just left?
That person... from under the\nhem of her robe...
Eh?
Something that looked like a\ntail...
W-what's happening!?
Kyaaa!?
What is it!?
Awawawawa! This is bad! This\nis terrible!!
Coro!?
Why on earth are you still\ndoing your ventriloquism act at\na time like this!?
(C-Coro! What's wrong!)
(It's the same thing! The forest\nalong the road to Carlone!

I saw them! I saw them with my
own eyes! Thornite! Thornite
are appearing all over the royal
capital!)"
Multiple high-density Gem\nreactions detected! Tika!

Whoa, Tika's Arms are actually
running on their own?! What is
this? How is this happening?!
Tell me how it works!!
Welch! Get back! Here they\ncome!!
Beast Witch: Ugh...!
I-I-I-I get it now! I thought that\nwas Karlyn Kayson!
If that wasn't Karlyn Kayson,\nthen we have a different\nproblem!
Tika! Do you remember what\nthe woman we passed was\nwearing?!
I... I didn't get a very good\nlook...
B-but her shoes were\ncompletely different! It's not\nher!
What?! You mean there might\nbe multiple Beast Witches in\nthe royal capital?!
It looks like that's exactly the\ncase!!

Hehehe... They fell for it even
more than I imagined. I wonder
if that "medicine" I let them
smell worked that well.
The guards are completely\nrattled.

<font color=blue>Karlyn's Subordinate</font>: Lady
Karlyn! The disruption of the
royal capital's east district
seems to be going smoothly.
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font>: I see. Good.

<font color=blue>Karlyn's Subordinate</font>: However,
it seems we are meeting quite
strong resistance around the
royal castle!
Reports say that many of our\ncomrades have already been\ndefeated.

<font color=blue>Karlyn</font>: ...Perhaps it's because
the attack happened to
coincide with Ricardo Franz's
return, contrary to the original
plan.
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font>: I suppose the knights\naround the castle aren't so\neasily shaken.
<font color=blue>Karlyn's Subordinate</font>: What\nshould we do?

<font color=blue>Karlyn</font>: Send out a new order.
The primary objective of
throwing the capital of
Rubarika into chaos has
already been achieved.

You Beast Witches are vital
assets to Baschen. If you feel
your lives are in danger,
retreat without hesitation.
I will go rescue our comrades\ncurrently operating around the\nroyal castle.
<font color=blue>Karlyn's Subordinate</font> Isn't that\ndangerous?
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> I have to save the\ncomrades I can.
Besides... even if Ricardo Franz\nhimself shows up, do you really\nthink I'd lose?
<font color=blue>Karlyn's Subordinate</font> ...No, I\noverstepped. Please forgive\nme.
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> You were just worried\nabout me, weren't you? It's\nalright, thank you.

You should also assess the
situation and return when the
time is right. I'll see you back
at the Imperial Castle.
Karlyn's Subordinate: Yes,\nma'am!
Just how many Beast Witches\nare there?!
What on earth was the guard\ndoing to allow this many\nintruders into the royal capital!
Hey! You there!!
Guard: Whoa!? H-help me...!

What the heck is going on! How
is it possible for this many of
Baschen's beasts to appear in
the royal capital!

Guard: I-I don't know! We
haven't received any orders at
all from headquarters or Lord
Delta!

Guard: We're fighting
desperately all over the place,
but there's no way we can hold
them off, so I came here to ask
for instructions!
Guard: Get out of my way!
Hey, wait a minute! Don't run\naway!
Does that mean the guards\naren't able to fight?
Things are starting to smell\nfishy.

That guard captain whose
attitude was strange from the
start... could he possibly be in
league with Baschen...?
...Spot on. You're quite the\nsharp one for such a little girl.
...No way... you've gotta be\nkidding...
Karlyn Kayson...! I can't believe\nyou'd show your face so\nbrazenly...!

I heard there were some tough
opponents here, and when I
arrived, I saw some familiar
faces. I'm actually a little
happy.
Gee... I would've preferred it if\nyou'd just forgotten what I look\nlike.

You were the first ones to
stand your ground against my
beasts. How could I possibly
forget?
You're the one who planned\nthis attack!

Do you have any idea how
many people in the Royal
Capital were sacrificed
because of this?! I'll never
forgive you!

...I have no need for your
forgiveness, but I won't forgive
you if you get in my way any
longer.
As much as I'll miss you, this\ntime, you're going to die right\nhere.
Not again!!
Sparkling stars! Become the\nlamp that guides him!!
That werewolf was in the\nforest...!
Now... this one is strong. I\nwonder how far he can push\nhimself?
Warping... bending... bursting...
Good. Truly wonderful.
Karlyn Kayson, magnificent.
My eyes did not deceive me\nwhen I discovered your talent...!
The moon cannot shine on its\nown. And yet, it dares to stand\nequal to the sun.
Mastima. You called this an act\nof recklessness; what do you\nthink now that you see this?
If you call yourself human, then\nshed a single tear for this\nsight!
Did it stop...?

LET ME OUT! LET ME OUT!
LET ME OUT! LET ME OUT!
LET ME OUT! LET ME
OUTTTTTTT! DAMN IT
ALLLLLLLL!
...Welch, you are being far too\nnoisy.
HOW AM I SUPPOSED TO\nACCEPT THIS kind of\ntreatment!!!!
Euwin, could you please find a\nway to silence Welch?
...If we were in the same cell, I\nwould have just knocked her\nunconscious.
DAMN IT ALLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!
(I wonder if Coro could teleport\nus out of here.)
(If that were possible, I believe\nit would have been done long\nago.

Either the Captain is choosing
not to, or this dungeon is
equipped with a field that
blocks special energy.)
Welch, be quiet for a second.\nVerda, Tika, how is Evelysse doing?
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: ...Yeah, she's not very\nenergetic, but she seems okay.

Evelysse, the Captain is right. The
Rubarika guards are the ones
acting strange; you've done
nothing wrong.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: ...I know. But I still can't help\nit...
Celestial Calling!!
Gwah!
D-did she... actually defeat\nthem...?
That power... that crest disc...\nwho are you?!

I'm the one who should be
asking that! What is that
summoning crest art, and
where did you get it?! You're
going to tell me everything!
I already told you. Even if I\ndid...
Just do it!!
Just... please tell me...!
Evelysse...?
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: I... I don't know why I have this\npower.
What are you talking about?

Summoning Symbology... I don't
know why I can use it, or how I
learned it. I don't know
anything!
So tell me! How did you get\nthat power?!
Why can you summon\nThornite?! Tell me, why?!
Evelysse! Calm yourself!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: I-I don't know what's going on,\nbut... Verda is right, Evelysse.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Whatever you want to ask can\nwait. First, we need to deal\nwith these restraints...
Guard: There they are! Over\nthere!
Guard B: It's the Beast Witch!
Guard C: I saw her! These\npeople are with the Beast\nWitch too!
What?!
Huh?!
Guard C: I saw Baschen's\nbeast emerge from a strange\ndisc!
Guard C: This woman\nsummoned the same disc!
N-no, she didn't! Evelysse is not like\nthat!!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
Guard C: Shut up! Are you a
spy for Baschen too?! I'll show
no mercy, even to a child!
Seize them!
No!!
Tika!
Hostile action against Tika\ndetected! Activating defense\nmode! Counterattacking...!
Rekoro! Hold it!!
But!
The odds are against us...!
It seems... they aren't in the\nmood to listen to our excuses\nright now.
What on earth... is going on...?
Guard: Seize them all!
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> Everyone... Tika, I'm so\nsorry...
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: We were so close to meeting\nGeneral Ricardo, but now it's all\nbecause of me...
<font color=blue>Tika</font> That's not true! It's not\nyour fault, Evelysse!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Big sister Eve -> Evelysse (Global drops お姉ちゃん), the user's decision

en: <font color=blue>Welch</font> Exactly! No matter how\nyou look at it, the royal guards\nare the ones who are crazy!
Of all things, they lump us in\nwith the Beast Witch? What\nthe heck are they looking at!!

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Verda was talking to the
Beast Witch, and Delta was in
league with Baschen. They
can't have us spreading that
word around.

<font color=blue>Welch</font> I heard that, but... is that
actually possible? Are you sure
that witch isn't just making
things up?

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> The fact that so many
beasts and the Beast Witch
were able to slip into the
capital,

the fact that they branded us
as Baschen's spies from the
start and threw us in prison
without a proper investigation,

and the timing of General
Ricardo's return from the front
lines... No one else but him
could pull this off.

<font color=blue>Tika</font> What about Big Brother
Euwin? You're one of the most
powerful nobles in the country!
How could they do this to
you...?

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Ordinary people are
shocked when they hear the
name Rakstar, but the
high-ranking officials and other
nobles in the know don't care.
Everyone knows that the fifth\nson of the Rakstar family has\nzero political influence.
If anything, they might even be\nusing me as a pawn to shake\nup the Rakstar house.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> That's...
<font color=blue>Welch</font> ...Every single one of\nthem is just filthy.

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Still, we fell right into
their trap. I'm beat; our
weapons are gone, and we
have no allies.
I just hope General Ricardo is\neager to see Tika, but...

As the general in command of
the front lines, he's probably
being grilled for letting an
enemy commander penetrate
all the way to the royal capital,
so we'll likely be stuck here for
a while.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Eu! Are you okay with\nthis?! At this rate, it'll be time\nsoon...!
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> ...Of course I'm not okay\nwith it! But there's nothing we\ncan do in a situation like this!
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> ...The Holy War will be\nover soon.
<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> Over? What do you mean?
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Euwin, you said you were\ntraveling in order to end the\nHoly War, didn't you?

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Once the Ladder of
Moonlight descends upon the
Holy Land, the side that
occupies the land at that
moment is declared the victor.
After that, a de facto ceasefire\nremains in effect until the time\nfor the next descent is known.

<font color=blue>Welch</font> It's been nearly a year
since this Holy Land War
began, so it wouldn't be
strange for the Ladder to
descend any time now...
And then, everyone will forget\nthe current tragedy and start\npreparing for the next war.

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Time and time again,
Rubarika and Baschen have
slaughtered one another just
to obtain the "Power of the
Envoy," which may not even
descend.
And every time, it only brought\ntragedy.
Enough of this already. What\nmore could they possibly\nwant?

Both Rubarika and Baschen
are strong enough; they've
received more than enough
benefits.

Masked Man: The more money
you have, the better. You're
not such a brat that you don't
understand that, are you?
Y-you!

Masked Man: The more money,
the better. You're not such a
brat that you don't understand
that, are you?
Y-you!
